assignment:
Some of your friends perform community service. For example, some tutor elementary school children and others clean up litter. They think helping the community is very important. But other friends of yours think community service takes too much time away from what they need or want to do. 
Your principal is deciding whether to require all students to perform community service. 
Write a letter to your principal in which you take a position on whether students should be required to perform community service. Support your position with examples.
essay_1:
Dear Principal,

I think students should have to do community service. Some of my friends tutor little kids at the elementary school, and others pick up trash in the neighborhood parks. I think these things show that helping people is important. It also helps students see how our community works outside of school.

Some students say community service takes time away from homework, sports, jobs, or other stuff. But a few hours a month is not a lot, and most kids can fit it in with their schedules. Also, we learn things like patience, teamwork, and responsibility, which will help us in school and later at our jobs.

Requiring service also makes things fair for everyone. If all students have to do it, nobody gets left out, and the school feels more caring. Please think about adopting this rule for next year.

Sincerely,
A Concerned Student
essay_2:
Dear Principal,

I think students should have to do community service. Some of my friends tutor little kids at the elementary school, and others pick up litter in the neighborhood parks. These jobs show students how our town works outside of class, and they are a useful way to spend time.

Some kids say service takes time away from homework, sports, or jobs. That is a problem, and it can be hard to fit in. But it is only a few hours a month, so most students can plan around it. Service is not always fun, but it teaches patience, teamwork, and responsibility. Those skills will be useful at school and at work later.

Requiring service also makes things fair. When everyone helps, nobody is left out. Students get to know people they would never meet otherwise, and the school becomes a place where people look out for each other. I hope you will approve this requirement. Students will learn a lot from it.

Sincerely,
A Concerned Student
